settings.title: Page and nav heading of the mail settings screen. 1 word. Same as nav.settings.mail.
settings.enabledLabel: Label next to the on/off toggle for the mailbox. ≤2 words.
settings.lastSync: Caption prefix before a timestamp showing when the mailbox last synced. ≤2 words.
settings.testConnection: Button that fires a smoke IMAP+SMTP check against the current settings. ≤2 words.
settings.testing: Label of that button while the check is in flight. Ends with an ellipsis character. ≤2 words.
settings.testOk: Inline confirmation shown next to the test button when both checks passed. A whole sentence, not a bare word. No trailing period.
settings.testFailed: Inline error shown next to the test button when the check failed and no server message is available. A whole sentence. No trailing period.
settings.status.disconnected: Status badge when the IMAP session is not active. 1 word. Polish agrees with 'skrzynka' (feminine).
settings.status.connected: Status badge when the IMAP session is healthy. 1 word. Polish agrees with 'skrzynka' (feminine).
settings.status.reconnecting: Status badge while the worker is retrying the IMAP connection. ≤2 words. Ends with an ellipsis character.
settings.status.error: Status badge when the connection has failed permanently until config changes. 1 word.
settings.identity.title: Section heading in the mailbox settings form for the 'from' name and address. 1 word.
settings.identity.fromName: Label of the sender display-name field — the human-readable part before the email address in outgoing mail. ≤2 words.
settings.identity.fromAddress: Label of the sender email address field. ≤2 words.
settings.identity.name: Label of the optional mailbox label field — an internal name to identify this connection. ≤2 words.
settings.imap.host: Label of the IMAP server hostname field. 1 word (technical term, same in Polish).
settings.imap.secureHint: Hint under the IMAP TLS checkbox explaining 993 vs 143. One short sentence.
settings.smtp.secureHint: Hint under the SMTP TLS checkbox explaining 465 vs 587 STARTTLS. One short sentence. No error jargon.
settings.imap.hostPlaceholder: Placeholder showing an example IMAP hostname. Literal example — not translated.
settings.imap.port: Label of the IMAP port number field. 1 word (technical term, same in Polish).
settings.imap.user: Label of the IMAP account username field. 1 word.
settings.imap.password: Label of the IMAP account password field. 1 word.
settings.smtp.host: Label of the SMTP server hostname field. 1 word (technical term, same in Polish).
settings.smtp.hostPlaceholder: Placeholder showing an example SMTP hostname. Literal example — not translated.
settings.smtp.port: Label of the SMTP port number field. 1 word (technical term, same in Polish).
settings.smtp.user: Label of the SMTP account username field. 1 word.
settings.smtp.password: Label of the SMTP account password field. 1 word.
settings.google.title: Section heading for Google Workspace / Gmail OAuth connect. ≤3 words.
settings.google.hint: Short explanation that Login with Google configures IMAP/SMTP automatically. One sentence.
settings.google.connect: Primary button that starts Google OAuth for the firm mailbox. Imperative. ≤4 words.
settings.google.disconnect: Button that revokes the stored Google token. Imperative. ≤2 words.
settings.google.connectedAs: Status line after Google is connected. {email} is the mailbox address.
settings.google.connectedFlash: Banner after a successful OAuth redirect. Whole sentence.
settings.google.errorFlash: Banner after a failed OAuth redirect when no server detail is available.
settings.google.hostsManaged: Info panel replacing IMAP/SMTP fields when Google OAuth is active.
toast.googleDisconnected: Toast after disconnecting Google from the mailbox.
errors.googleOAuth: Toast when starting Google OAuth fails.
inbox.title: Page heading of the company inbox screen showing all mail threads. 1 word. Polish: 'Skrzynka odbiorcza'.
inbox.settings: Link / button that navigates to the mailbox settings page. ≤2 words.
inbox.refresh: Button that re-fetches the thread list. Imperative, 1 word.
panel.compose: Button that opens the compose form to start a new email thread from a contact or lead panel. Imperative, ≤2 words.
panel.cancelCompose: Button that hides the compose form without sending. Imperative, ≤2 words.
panel.correspondenceTitle: Section heading above the list of email threads on a lead or contact page. Noun phrase, ≤2 words.
thread.noSubject: Fallback label shown when a thread has an empty subject line. Parenthesised noun phrase, ≤3 words.
thread.unknownContact: Shown in a thread row when the sender could not be matched to a CRM contact. ≤2 words.
thread.messageCount: Count of messages in a thread. PLURAL — {n} is the number. Polish needs three forms (one | few | many). Must fit a narrow column.
thread.delete.action: Accessible name of the Delete button in the inbox thread detail header. Imperative, ≤2 words.
thread.delete.title: Confirm-dialog title when deleting a whole conversation from the CRM inbox. Question. ≤4 words.
thread.delete.message: Confirm-dialog body. {subject} is the thread subject (or the no-subject fallback). Explains permanent removal of the whole thread from the CRM inbox. One or two short sentences. Use typographic quotes around {subject}.
thread.delete.confirm: Confirm-dialog primary (danger) button. Names the object, e.g. “Delete thread”. Imperative.
thread.delete.deleting: Label of the Delete button while the request is in flight. Ends with an ellipsis character. ≤2 words.
capture.banner: Banner text in the inbox detail pane when the thread has no CRM contact. Explains the sender is unknown and invites adding them. One short sentence.
capture.cta: Primary button on that banner that opens the add-contact+lead modal. Imperative. ≤4 words.
capture.title: Modal title when creating a contact and lead from an unknown mail sender. Noun phrase. ≤4 words.
capture.hint: Short helper under the modal title: user can copy the name from the message snippet below. One short sentence.
capture.messageHint: Label above the read-only snippet of the first inbound message body inside the capture modal. ≤3 words.
capture.submit: Primary submit button of the capture modal. Creates contact + lead and links the thread. Imperative. ≤3 words.
toast.captured: Toast after a sender was added as contact+lead from mail. Whole sentence. No trailing period.
errors.capture: Toast when capture-as-lead fails and the server sent no message. Whole sentence. No trailing period.
direction.inbound: Badge label on a received message or thread. 1 word, sentence case. Polish agrees with 'wiadomość' (feminine).
direction.outbound: Badge label on a sent message or thread. 1 word, sentence case. Polish agrees with 'wiadomość' (feminine).
message.to: Prefix before the recipient address in a message header row. 1 word.
message.failed: Badge label on a message that failed to send. 1 word, sentence case. Polish agrees with 'wiadomość' (feminine).
message.pending: Badge label on an outbound message not yet delivered. 1 word, sentence case. Polish agrees with 'wiadomość' (feminine).
message.retry: Button below a failed message to resend it. Imperative, ≤2 words.
message.retrying: Label while the retry is in flight. Ends with an ellipsis character. ≤2 words.
toast.deleted: Toast after a thread was deleted from the CRM inbox. Whole sentence. No trailing period.
errors.delete: Toast when deleting a thread fails and the server sent no message. Whole sentence. No trailing period.
compose.subject: Label of the subject-line field in the compose form. 1 word.
compose.body: Label of the message body textarea in the compose and reply forms. 1 word.
compose.send: Primary button of the compose form. Imperative, 1 word.
compose.sending: Label of that button while the request is in flight. Ends with an ellipsis character. ≤2 words.
reply.title: Section heading above the reply textarea. Noun, 1 word.
reply.send: Primary button of the reply form. Imperative, ≤2 words.
reply.sending: Label of that button while the request is in flight. Ends with an ellipsis character. ≤2 words.
toast.sent: Toast confirming a compose or reply was sent. A whole sentence — not a bare word like 'Sent'. No trailing period.
aiSuggest.generate: Button label that triggers AI draft generation in the reply panel.
aiSuggest.generating: Loading state for the AI generate button. Ends with ellipsis character.
aiSuggest.instructionPlaceholder: Placeholder for the optional instruction input next to the generate button.
